verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover the hardware media engines. NVENC supports H.264, HEVC and AV1, with new 4:2:2 H.264/HEVC encode, improved HEVC/AV1 quality, and NVDEC 4:2:2 decode. Creator-app acceleration is claimed across 100+ professional and creative applications for livestreaming, editing and media workflows. Missing for 10: any documentation of professional or ISV-certified driver support, named creator-app integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of encoder performance.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it

citations.quote: NVIDIA GPUs hardware-accelerated video encoder (NVENC), provides video encoding for H.264, HEVC (H.265) and AV1 codecs.
They add new support for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC encoding and improve HEVC and AV1 encoding quality.
NVIDIA Blackwell introduces 422 progressive and interlaced encode support in hardware, enabling professional use cases in media and entertainment, video editing and broadcast.
With enhanced AV1 and H.265 codec support, it's ideal for livestreaming, real-time editing, and live media workflows.
Over 100 professional and creative applications leverage RTX to accelerate performance
